svg.title: Logarithmic-Hamming-Numbers
svg.desc: Left: the 200 lattice points (i, j, k) with i ln 2 + j ln 3 + k ln 5 at or below the bound B, filling a tetrahedron in log space; the 200th Hamming number, 16200 = 2^3 · 3^4 · 5^2, sits on the boundary plane. Right: for n = 1,000,000,000 the geometric guess is off by 287 points, and a Newton step and three secant steps close the gap to exactly n, giving 2^1334 · 3^335 · 5^404, an 844-digit number.
svg.text: i ln2 + j ln3 + k ln5 ≤ B
and a band of a few points
